title: Ekonomi Sumber Daya Alam dan Lingkungan
subtitle: Ekonomi Sumber Daya Alam dan Lingkungan
blurb: This book explores the strategic intersection of sustainability, business, and economics, offering an interdisciplinary perspective on how organizations and economies can create long-term value while addressing environmental and societal challenges. Drawing on contemporary scholarship in sustainable business, natural capital, ecosystem services, green innovation, circular economy, and responsible governance, it provides an academically rigorous yet accessible framework for advancing resilient, inclusive, and nature-positive economies.
